title: Grimoire Spell
description: A grimoire spell — one declared state. Source of truth for the on-disk YAML format. Mirrors `Spell` in src/spell.rs. CI uses this to validate every shipped spell, and IDEs (yaml-language-server) use it for autocomplete and inline lint while authoring.

name.description: Unique spell identifier. Kebab-case, must start with a lowercase letter.

verify.description: Bash snippet that exits 0 iff the desired state is currently reached.

version_check.description: Bash snippet that prints the currently-installed version on stdout. Required for any manifest entry that uses a version constraint.

description.description: Long-form documentation, shown in `grimoire show` and the GUI detail view.

maintainer.description: Contact for upstream issues with the spell itself.

category.description: Free-form grouping label for the GUI and `grimoire ls --category`.

tags.description: Free-form tags for search and filtering.

distros.description: Distros this spell is known to work on. Empty = universal. Tool checks /etc/os-release.

items.description: Constraint on another spell. Same syntax as manifest entries: 'name', 'name >= 1.0', 'name >= 1.0, < 2.0'.

before.description: Bash snippet run before any cast channel.

after.description: Bash snippet run after the chosen cast channel succeeds. Failures in `after` are warned but don't fail the cast.

default.description: Channel key used when none is specified by the user or manifest. Must match a key in `channels`.

channels.description: One or more named install channels. Keys are referenced by `--via <key>` and by manifest overrides.

provides.description: Informational. Used for cross-spell reasoning later (e.g. transitive `provides` could obviate `requires`).

type.description: Channel kind. Drives GUI badges, channel-specific update probes, and implicit distro applicability (e.g. `dnf` ⇒ Fedora-family).

summary.description: Per-channel description shown when listing alternatives.

run.description: Bash snippet executed to install via this channel.

version_hint.description: What kind of version this channel typically delivers. Helps the tool pick a channel when a constraint isn't satisfied.

requires_sudo.description: Set true if the channel's `run` invokes sudo. Informational; the tool does not invoke sudo on the channel's behalf.

distros.description: Distros this channel applies to. Empty/omitted ⇒ use the implicit list from `type` (e.g. `dnf` ⇒ Fedora-family). Set this only to override that default — for instance to restrict a `shell` channel to one distro, or to broaden a `dnf` channel to OpenSUSE forks.
